scope: Bounded read-only analogue-network/production-ADC integration check; no repeated full pin audit

mux.U401_0x40_MUX0_gain8_PGA: J401+ through R402 to AIN0 minus J401- through R401 to AIN1
mux.U401_0x40_MUX6_gain8_PGA: J402 center through R406 to AIN2 minus shield through R405 to AIN3
mux.U502_0x41_MUX0_gain1_bypass: RN501 HE_REF through R506 to AIN0 minus J501.2 HE_SENSE through R507 to AIN1
mux.U502_0x41_MUXA_gain1_bypass: AIN2=HE_EXC_DIV relative AVSS; software multiplies by2

O2_diff.warning: Source impedance and real capacitance unmeasured; open input decay is slow and is not a reliable disconnected-cell test.

O2_input_common_mode.assumption: Identical nominal10nF input capacitors, four1Mohm links and1uF VMID capacitor; not tolerance-qualified.

settling.note: These resistance conditions ignore capacitor tolerance and the coupled common-mode network; no upper settling guarantee can be assigned from the unmeasured sensor.

resistor_only_initial_bounds.scope: Ratios conservatively use individual0.1% tolerance; matched-array tracking can improve correlation. No unspecified discrete-resistor TCR bound is assumed.

ADC_and_LDO_limits.qualification: LDO limits require its specified line/load/temperature and effective COUT conditions. Midpoint0..excitation is an assumed passive electrical envelope, not MD62 characterization. ADC reference-only bounds omit offset, gain, drift and noise.

noise_typical_not_maximum.note: TI shorted-input characterization only; actual gas pp requires measured sensitivity, source impedance, leakage and environmental error. Input-current and bypass offset/gain figures are typical, not guaranteed worst-case limits.

timing.note: 20SPS describes each ADC integration setting, not delivered gas frames. Bus traffic, polling, RTOS ticks, contention, faults and reinitialization lower frame rate.

holds: Confirm cell/MD62 source impedance and step settling; capacitors still need selected tolerance/DC-bias/temperature qualification.
